verdict.rationale: Restate documents fan-out patterns that run many tasks in parallel with independent retries and preserved results (restate-docs-52, restate-docs-50). The CLI and SQL introspection API can query and manage invocations across the system (restate-docs-10, restate-docs-43), so work across many items can be built and inspected. However, there is no documented first-class bulk-action feature such as batch cancel/kill/restart or batch submission. Missing for 10: explicit bulk operations on many invocations or items (e.g., batch cancel or retry via CLI/API), batch ingestion APIs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
